name: Nikaidou Akira
source:
2nd year high school student.
Hobbies: Napping, Teasing Kengo, Reading (Mainly untranslated western books)

He has a bad mouth and often gets into fights.
He's smart but he hates going to school and so has bad grades.
He really loves that belt choker and is always wearing it.
